title: Quant telemetry fast-fail gate and version-pin approval workflow for quantized rollouts
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Add an automated telemetry-based gate and human approval flow into the quantized model onboarding pipeline. Goal is to detect perf/quality regressions early during canary traffic for INT8/FP8/GPTQ/AWQ variants and either fast-fail the rollout or escalate to an approval board. This ticket implements the metric contracts, sampling strategy, dashboarding, alerting, and the version-pin propagation so a safe variant can be pinned automatically or by a reviewer. Should integrate with existing publish pipeline, canary router, and the release pin registry.
acceptance_criteria: A metrics contract (latency P50/P95, token cost, accuracy proxy) is defined per model family and stored in the model manifest
Canary ingestion pipeline emits per-variant telemetry to the quant-canary namespace with <1s freshness
Automated gate that compares canary variant metrics to baseline and marks candidate as PASSED / FAILED using pre-configured thresholds
Failed canaries trigger automatic rollback to previous pinned version and create an incident ticket with diagnostic links
Human approval UI (Console) shows candidate diff, telemetry charts, and a single-click pin/rollback action; approval events are audit-logged
Dashboard and alerting playbooks are published: Confluence doc, Grafana dashboard link, and PagerDuty schedule mapping
End-to-end tests exercising a synthetic canary run are added to CI and must pass before merge
